own_symbolic_findings: At time t with fixed horizon h and X_s observed by s, Y_(s+h) is known iff s+h<=t. Ignoring start/missing data, h pending rows per cell; one for h=1. Ch raw rows are not automatically independent samples.
For multi-output horizons partially observed target prefixes differ from fully unobserved targets. Known prefixes do not reveal unknown future suffixes.

Under support overlap and integrability E_Q f + E_P[(dQ_X/dP_X)(Y-f)] = E_Q mu_P, with discrepancy E_Q(mu_P-mu_Q) from a shifted conditional mean. Correcting input shift alone does not remove arbitrary conditional drift.
Two environments with the same observed past and current inputs but different future conditional laws cannot always be distinguished at the current boundary without additional assumptions.

Traffic-label inference and risk of an as-yet untrained grouped RCTL are different estimands. Using learned RCTL predictions/losses in the clustering correction would change the independence requirement.
decision: Do not add a delayed-label PPI module to the present static one-step clustering proposal. Not a universal impossibility claim for delayed forecasting or PPI.
